study.question: Does an explicit low-rank context-by-compressed-history product add useful task-conditioned representation beyond a parameter-matched sum branch, and does that gain depend on auxiliary adapter-context supervision?
study.hypothesis: Observed: incumbent g0-r0031-adapter_context_only click AUC0.6670575100016033 exceeds frozen source bests0.660646940486458/0.660163362657485 and its context-blocked endpoint0.6668051956575413, but this is single-seed. Naive compressed-task g0-r0006-compressed_task failed at0.6591942389399411; match-detail task routing later reached0.6630190236433535. Shared-curvature0.6637270504369936 is below its archived task counterpart, so retain task-specific representations. Recent context tangent0.6669068957035179, radial0.6664308335304835, conflict0.6670528225652198 and conflict norm control0.6670450535932775 do not improve the incumbent. This does not establish harmful gradient conflict. Source audit shows the current adapter first mixes context and history additively into only16 ReLU units; its explicit products are target/history relevance, not projected context/history fusion. This is a structural limitation, not measured interaction underfitting. A task-specific rank16 product residual may provide a useful inductive bias for context-sensitive use of compressed history, with auxiliary context updates supporting that representation. The claim is about this tested implementation, not novelty or general sufficiency of multiplication.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary sections4.2/4.3 (lines219-277) inspected: target-conditioned local activation and explicit relevance interaction are inherited concepts. New branch fuses context with already compressed/matched history after pooling, per task; no new DIN-attention or exact-reproduction claim.

Authorized section2.3 describes stacked and layer-wise unified methods, including feature-conditioned queries/low-rank mixing for HeMix and sequence/global queries for HyFormer. Proposed branch is a single post-compression task residual; no iterative token mixing or per-layer sequence update is added. These are benchmark descriptions, not original-method audits.

All incumbent embeddings, five target-match/order summaries, ten-block compression, action-aware scorer, folded training Dice support/pruned eval, four existing adapters and towers, independent auxiliary Dice buffers.
Auxiliary item/action/scorer and direct-tower context detaches; incumbent adapter context gate reused as factorial factor.
All native inherited initialization calls and RNG order; new modules appended inside the existing fork_rng after inherited adapters; zero new output matrices. No loss hook or data access added.
study.proposed_difference: For each task append bias-free U:C->r, V:(6D+3)->r and W:r->D, with C192,D112,r16 on released feature map. h concatenates that task base summary, three existing match counts and five existing masked summary vectors; q contains only supplied context. Compute a=tanh(Uq), b=tanh(Vh) in FP32; z=a*b for product or (a+b)/sqrt(2) for sum; z=z/sqrt(mean(z^2)+1e-4); add Wz (cast back to history dtype) to the existing correction under its has_history gate. No labels, cross-example mixing, extra history positions, task identifiers outside existing head routing or external data enter forward. U/V/W identical in all cells; W initially zero. Cross fusion with existing block_aux_adapter_context_grad=False/True, affecting both inherited and appended adapter context edges; every branch parameter stays task-trained. Exact added parameters=4r(C+7D+3)=62656; expected total32192421. This is a new forward intervention after unsuccessful backward-only trajectories.

falsifiers: Product fails the primary utility gate versus incumbent and sum; useful incremental product fusion is unsupported for this implementation. A sum-only gain favors added capacity/fusion over product-specific explanation.

No positive factorial interaction or enabled product does not beat blocked product: auxiliary-enabled product complementarity is unsupported even if multiplication itself helps.
A gain requiring measured cost beyond declared efficiency gate is not a justified efficiency improvement; report the quality/cost tradeoff instead.
